title: Trusted structured Frontend parity refresh dispatch

phases.objective: Consume the exact structured Frontend surface dispatch artifact from a trusted workflow_run context, preserve the synthetic merge-candidate identity separately from the pull-request source-head identity exposed by workflow_run.head_sha, and delegate the registered exact-head generated-artifact refresh only when committed deterministic parity is the sole reported failure and the pull request carries explicit refresh authorization.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted repository automation and pull-request reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A completed failed Frontend surface dispatch workflow with its exact structured evidence artifact
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The trusted dispatcher either skips unrelated failures, fails closed on malformed or stale evidence, or delegates the registered generated-artifact refresh for the exact labeled pull-request source head without conflating it with the synthetic merge candidate, reading Job logs, or mutating repository contents directly.
steps: Receive only completed failed Frontend surface dispatch workflow_run events.
Run from the trusted default-branch workflow definition with actions write, contents read, and pull-requests read permissions.
Use stable repository-relative evidence directories rather than unavailable jobs-level runner context expressions.
Validate the canonical contract, exact run ID, candidate_kind=merge_candidate, full merge-candidate SHA, full source-head SHA, main base, no-secret declaration, and consult_job_logs=false.
Bind workflow_run.head_sha to source_head_sha while retaining candidate_sha as separate merge-candidate evidence.
Require outcome=failed and first_failure.stage_id=committed_generated_parity; skip every other result without mutation.
Resolve exactly one open same-repository pull request for the evidence head ref.
Require exact source-head parity and the generated-artifact-refresh label.
Dispatch governed-generated-artifact-refresh.yml on main with the exact target ref, source-head SHA, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH confirmation.
Upload mad4b.frontend-parity-refresh-dispatch.v1 before enforcing the decision.
assertions: The canonical Frontend report identifies candidate_sha as a synthetic merge candidate and source_head_sha as the pull-request head.
workflow_run.head_sha equals source_head_sha and is never compared to candidate_sha.
The source report run_id equals the triggering workflow_run ID and candidate_kind equals merge_candidate.
The pull request must be same-repository and its current head must equal source_head_sha before dispatch.
Only committed_generated_parity is eligible for delegated refresh.
Missing artifacts, malformed identity, ambiguous PR resolution, stale heads, and rejected dispatches fail closed with bounded structured diagnostics.
Absent refresh authorization or unrelated failures are skipped without repository mutation.
Job logs are diagnostic-only and are never consulted by the dispatcher.
The dispatcher has no contents-write permission and performs no direct git push.
The delegated writer remains the registered workflow_dispatch-only generated-artifact refresh workflow.
Protected-branch mutation and force push remain false.

phases.objective: Publish the dispatcher report into the shared canonical pull-request evidence surface after the first successful exact-head delegation is observed.

Exercise missing artifacts, malformed reports, source-head versus merge-candidate mismatch, cancelled source runs, stale PR heads, ambiguous PRs, label removal races, dispatch API rejection, and repeated workflow_run delivery.
Observe one labeled non-production pull request move from committed parity failure to an exact-source-head generated refresh commit and passing verification without manual Job-log reconstruction.
This repository dispatcher grants no deployment, migration, runtime, provider, credential, or Production authority.
